title: [finding] ListMapConfigSchema docblock states an extra key in `map` 「would be dropped」 by the renderer — measured at the pin, objectui neither drops nor flags it, and that false sentence is the stated rationale for the strictness protecting authors
body:
Filed by the `domain:spec` execution seat **3** (#18883), `session_019srGWGCBBCBHqcDoRZpQRh`, R1, from the `out_of_scope_findings` of the #18406 round (PR #18904). ⛔ Filed bare (no `domain:*`, no `priority:*`): 「执行席永不定级或路由裸卡」. ⛔ Not deduped by this seat — dedupe words at the bottom. The reporting dev explicitly declined to grade the filing class and left it to the seat; the grading below is **the seat's**, and it is the seat that is answerable for it.

## The claim

`packages/spec/src/ui/view.zod.ts`, the `ListMapConfigSchema` docblock, retained verbatim by PR #18904 at roughly `:1747-1748`:

> `…it validates `schema.map` against a local zod schema with exactly these keys, so an extra key here would be dropped there.`

That sentence is the **stated rationale** for the block being `strictObject`.

## It is measurably false at the pin

Three readings at the `.objectui-sha` pin `53ded82b`, taken by the #18406 round and reported rather than acted on:

1. **`ObjectMapConfigSchema` is a plain `z.object`, NOT strict** — objectui `packages/types/src/zod/objectql.zod.ts:562`. ⇒ a `safeParse` of a `map` block carrying an undeclared key **SUCCEEDS**, and no warning is emitted.
2. **`getMapConfig` never uses that parse result as the value** — objectui `plugin-map/src/ObjectMap.tsx:373-376` consults it only to decide whether to `console.warn`.
3. **The authored block is passed through by spread** — objectui `plugin-map/src/ObjectMap.tsx:378` returns a spread of the **authored** object, so an undeclared key is **carried through**.

⇒ An undeclared key inside `map` is **neither flagged nor dropped** by the renderer. That is the **opposite** of what the docblock asserts.

## Why the seat grades this class (b), violating a declared contract

A spec docblock is named governing text in this repo's own decision discipline (`Governing text:` = AGENTS.md / ADR / **spec docblock** / lint rule). This one declares a mechanism — "would be dropped there" — that the measured implementation does not perform. Under the standing basic ruling principle (spec 声明 > 实现 > 文档面;声明而未兑现是实现缺口), a declaration the implementation does not honour is a gap to close, ⛔ not prose to soften.

⛔ **The seat does NOT grade it class (c).** Today `ListMapConfigSchema` is `strictObject`, so an undeclared key inside `map` is refused at the **authoring** door before any renderer sees it. An author — human or AI — is protected right now, so this is not a live 「metadata silently dropped or rejected」 trap.

⚠️ **The hazard is second-order, and it is the reason this is worth a card rather than a note.** The false sentence is the *argument for* the strictness that currently protects authors. A future editor who reads it, believes the renderer drops extras, and therefore relaxes this block to `passthrough` would get the opposite of what the sentence promises: keys silently carried into the renderer, unflagged and unvalidated. ⇒ a false rationale invites exactly the wrong future decision, and it sits in the file where that decision would be made.

## Why PR #18904 deliberately did NOT fix it

The #18406 ruling (batch #153 item 4 letter 1) reaches the `style` key and objectui's read of it. It does **not** reach this clause. The dispatching seat instructed that the docblock correction stay within what the ruling's facts reach and that anything wider be reported instead of widening the diff — ⛔ a ruling does not license edits beyond its own findings. The clause was therefore kept byte-identical and reported. ⇒ This card is the successor, and it is a **deliberate** hand-off, not an oversight.

## Landing repo

`objectstack`, because the defective text is an objectstack docblock. ⚠️ Its **evidence** is entirely in objectui at a pin, so whoever takes it needs the pinned objectui checkout to re-verify, and ⛔ a reading taken against objectui `main` rather than the pin answers a different question.

## 查重词
